images.caption: Orthodox Holy Trinity St. Nicholas Chapel at Fort Ross, Sonoma County, California. The chapel is part of the Fort Ross State Historic Park. The chapel was originally built in the mid-1820s and got destroyed in the 1906 earthquake. In 1970, a restored version of the chapel was entirely destroyed in an accidental fire. The photo shows the reconstructed chapel, built in 1973. It continues to be used for Orthodox religious services.
images.alt: Orthodox Holy Trinity St. Nicholas Chapel at Fort Ross, Sonoma County, California. The chapel is part of the Fort Ross State Historic Park. The chapel was originally built in the mid-1820s and got destroyed in the 1906 earthquake. In 1970, a restored version of the chapel was entirely destroyed in an accidental fire. The photo shows the reconstructed chapel, built in 1973. It continues to be used for Orthodox religious services.

images.caption:
Kendall-Jackson Wine Center, Santa Rosa, California, USA
 Kendall-Jackson Wine Center .
Visiting Sonoma County's wine country is a spectacular experience with exquisite food, gorgeous scenery and fabulous wines. Kendall-Jackson brings the wine country to life at two tasting room locations.
Kendall-Jackson Wine Center is a magnificent château set on 120 acres in the heart of Sonoma County, wine and culinary aficionados gather to experience the charm, romance and flavors of the wine country. Enjoy a seated wine & food pairing, visit the tasting bar, browse for gifts and limited wines, and tour the vineyards and extensive flower, herb and vegetable gardens that surround the château.

The Healdsburg Tasting Room is just off the square in the quaint stylish town of Healdsburg. Our tasting room offers visitors the complete Kendall-Jackson portfolio of wines.
